messages:
maria: deploy-bot flagged payments-service canary in eu-west unhealthy after chart 1.4.2 promote. canary health=20% (2/10). crash in sidecar init with missing CONFIG_PATH.

deploy-bot: deploy 1766000000: canary rollout payments-service eu-west started. canary_fraction=10, healthy=2/10, last_failure=init, automated_action=suggest_pin
ryan: grabbing logs now.
maria: pod logs show: ```2024-06-01T09:14:02Z FATAL missing env CONFIG_PATH; aborting init
stack: init.go:92``` The 1.4.2 chart removed the default for CONFIG_PATH in templates (PR #390).
devon: I reproduced locally with `helm template` + our values: the sidecar.env block got templated as a map iteration which changed ordering and dropped `CONFIG_PATH` default when values.items absent. Ugly.
alex: two approaches: A) hotpatch canary values to explicitly set env/CONFIG_PATH and continue the rollout; B) pin eu-west to 1.4.1 and pause auto-promote until chart fix. Which minimizes blast radius?
lina: From ops view, hotpatching the canary values is lower blast radius if it will get fixed fast. But pins are safer for user-facing payment paths.
ryan: timeline: I can hotpatch and run a quick smoke for the canary in 15m. If canary passes I'll promote. If not, we'll pin and roll back. Command to hotpatch: ```kubectl -n eu-west patch deployment payments-service --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/metadata/annotations/patch-canary","value":"cfg-path-hotpatch-1766"}]' && kubectl -n eu-west set env deployment/payments-service CONFIG_PATH=/etc/payments/config.yaml --containers=sidecar```
maria: note: deploy-bot's promotion automation ignores runtime env annotations; need to set `deploy.redwood/allow_promote=false` to block automatic promotion until we're confident.
devon: also add a preflight check in the release pipeline: `helm test --timeout=60s` that validates sidecar init. Filing CHART-431 for that.
ryan: hotpatch applied at 1766000150. deploy-bot: observed canary restart at 1766000160. canary health now 60% (6/10).
lina: nice. run a quick payments acceptance smoke against canary endpoints (tokenized flows).
ryan: smoke pass at 1766000220. All basic flows good. I'll keep `deploy.redwood/allow_promote=false` for another hour and then re-evaluate.
maria: create release-note entry: "temporary hotpatch: set CONFIG_PATH env for payments-service canary in eu-west to mitigate 1.4.2 chart template change. Follow-up: CHART-431 revert template mapping and add unit test."
alex: open CHART-432 to revert the change in 1.4.2 and add rendering test. Also add OPS-92 for a controlled re-rollout window after tests.
deploy-bot: automation note: promotion blocked by annotation deploy.redwood/allow_promote=false. Manual promote allowed via `deploy-bot promote payments-service --region eu-west --confirm`
ryan: locking promotion for now. I will convert hotpatch into a temporary values override in the next helm release candidate and coordinate with release window 2024-06-02 01:00 UTC for final rollout.
devon: long-term fix: avoid map-based env templating; switch to explicit ordered list in chart and add tpl-based unit test.
alex: thanks everyone. we'll keep this thread updated. :white_check_mark:
